name: Murder In the Valley!
description: Interrogate chatGPT as it impersonates the different suspect in a murder case.
content: If you like detective games, this one leverages the power of chatGPT conversational power to makes for a very fun (and sometimes hilarious) experience. Key features: A UI to navigate between the different screens of the game, Leveraging chatGPT to impersonate the suspects and slip out clues after the right questions.
